messages.subject: For Bill McDermott | Corporate affairs, government relations and international partnerships
messages.body:
Dear ServiceNow Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Bill McDermott, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

ServiceNow's international growth increasingly intersects with governments, regulated industries, public institutions and strategic partnerships. Those priorities closely match the external leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex multinational operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of corporate affairs, government relations and emerging-market stakeholder execution could support ServiceNow's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to ServiceNow.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
